# Referrer-Policy & Permissions-Policy Checker

> Check your site's Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers for unsafe-url, invalid syntax and wildcard camera or microphone access. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
